```{r setup}
# Week ending function (Sunday)
closest_future_sunday <- function(date) {
  my_date <- ymd(date)
  my_day <- wday(my_date)
  shift <- ifelse(my_day <= 1, 0, 7)
  return(my_date + days(1 - my_day + shift))
}
```

```{r box updates}
#| warning: false

# # Boxes 

create_dynamic_value_box <- function(metric_name, current_val, target_val, prev_val, lower_is_better, format_type) {
  
  # Determine target performance (Colour)
  meets_target <- if(lower_is_better) current_val <= prev_val else current_val >= prev_val
  box_theme <- if (meets_target) "success" else "warning"
  
  # Determine week-on-week movement (Icon & Delta string)
  wow_diff <- current_val - prev_val
  
  if (wow_diff > 0) {
    wow_icon <- bsicons::bs_icon("arrow-up-right-circle-fill")
    direction_label <- "up"
  } else if (wow_diff < 0) {
    wow_icon <- bsicons::bs_icon("arrow-down-right-circle-fill")
    direction_label <- "down"
  } else {
    wow_icon <- bsicons::bs_icon("dash-circle-fill")
    direction_label <- "flat"
  }
  
  # Map specific showcase icon based on metric_name
  showcase_icon_name <- switch(
    metric_name,
    "Total Type 1 Attendances"     = "people",
    "Avoidable Attendances" = "person-badge",
    "A&E 4-Hour"     = "clock-history",
    "4-12 Hour Waits"       = "hourglass-split",
    "12+ Hour Waits"        = "exclamation-triangle",
    "activity" # Default fallback icon
  )
  
  showcase_icon <- bsicons::bs_icon(showcase_icon_name)
  
  # Format displayed main value
  formatted_val <- switch(
    format_type,
    "percent" = paste0(formatC(current_val, digits = 1, format = "f"), "%"),
    "number"  = formatC(current_val, big.mark = ",", format = "d"),
    "time"    = sprintf("%02d:%02d", floor(current_val), round((current_val %% 1) * 60)),
    as.character(current_val)
  )
  
  # Format WoW change string
  formatted_diff <- switch(
    format_type,
    "percent" = paste0(sprintf("%+.1f", wow_diff), "% WoW"),
    "number"  = paste0(sprintf("%+d", round(wow_diff)), " WoW"),
    "time"    = paste0(sprintf("%+.1f", wow_diff), " mins WoW"),
    paste0(sprintf("%+.1f", wow_diff), " WoW")
  )
  
  # Render value box
  bslib::value_box(
    title = metric_name,
    value = formatted_val,
    htmltools::p(wow_icon, formatted_diff),
    showcase = showcase_icon,
    theme = box_theme
  )
}
```

```{r functions}
# Policy change annotation

# Commentary Generation Function
generate_age_commentary <- function(data, age_group) {
  sub_df <- data |> 
    filter(AgeBand == age_group, Grp != "Other") |>
    arrange(desc(Total_Attendances)) |> 
    mutate(Group_Lower = str_to_lower(Grp))
  
  top_pct <- sub_df$Percentage[1]*100
  fraction_desc <- if (top_pct >= 50) "half" else if (top_pct >= 33.3) "a third" else if (top_pct >= 25) "a quarter" else "a fifth"
  
  sprintf(
    "For the <b>%s</b> cohort, the primary driver was <b>%s</b>,
    accounting for over %s (%.1f%%) of top-5 avoidable attendances, 
    followed by %s (%.1f%%) and %s (%.1f%%).",
    age_group,
    str_to_title(sub_df$Group_Lower[1]),
    fraction_desc,
    top_pct,
    sub_df$Group_Lower[2], sub_df$Percentage[2]*100,
    sub_df$Group_Lower[3], sub_df$Percentage[3]*100
  )
}

# Time Commentary Generation Function
generate_age_commentary_time <- function(data, age_group) {
  sub_df <- data |> 
    filter(AgeBand == age_group, Grp != "Other") |>
    arrange(desc(Avg_Time)) |> 
    mutate(Group_Lower = str_to_lower(Grp))
  
  top_pct <- sub_df$Percentage[1]*100
  fraction_desc <- if (top_pct >= 50) "half" else if (top_pct >= 33.3) "a third" else if (top_pct >= 25) "a quarter" else "a fifth"
  
  sprintf(
    "For the <b>%s</b> cohort, the primary driver was <b>%s</b>,
    accounting for over %s (%.1f%%) of top-5 average time, 
    followed by %s (%.1f%%) and %s (%.1f%%).",
    age_group,
    str_to_title(sub_df$Group_Lower[1]),
    fraction_desc,
    top_pct,
    sub_df$Group_Lower[2], sub_df$Percentage[2]*100,
    sub_df$Group_Lower[3], sub_df$Percentage[3]*100
  )
}

# Plotly Graphs All, Age, ICB & Trust 
plot_attendance_summary <- function(p_df, p_title, p_yaxis) {
  
  # 1. Prepare overall data
  df_overall <- p_df |> 
    group_by(Week) |> 
    summarise(Vol = sum(Attendances, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # 2. Prepare group-level data (Week + AgeBand)
  df_ageband <- p_df |> 
    group_by(Week, AgeBand) |> 
    summarise(Vol = sum(Attendances, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # 3. Prepare system-level data (Week + ICB)
  df_stp <- p_df |> 
    mutate(ICB = if_else(nchar(Stp) > 32, stringr::str_trunc(Stp, width = 32, side = "right", ellipsis = "..."), Stp)) |> 
    group_by(Week, ICB) |> 
    summarise(Vol = sum(Attendances, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # 4. Prepare provider-level data (Week + OrganisationName)
  df_org <- p_df |> 
    group_by(Week, OrganisationName) |> 
    summarise(Vol = sum(Attendances, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Determine unique categories
  unique_agebands <- unique(df_ageband$AgeBand)
  n_agebands <- length(unique_agebands)
  
  unique_stps <- unique(df_stp$ICB)
  n_stps <- length(unique_stps)
  
  unique_orgs <- unique(df_org$OrganisationName)
  n_orgs <- length(unique_orgs)
  
  # Configure visibility vectors for dynamic dropdown
  vis_overall <- c(TRUE,  rep(FALSE, n_agebands), rep(FALSE, n_stps), rep(FALSE, n_orgs))
  vis_ageband <- c(FALSE, rep(TRUE, n_agebands),  rep(FALSE, n_stps), rep(FALSE, n_orgs))
  vis_stp     <- c(FALSE, rep(FALSE, n_agebands), rep(TRUE, n_stps),  rep(FALSE, n_orgs))
  vis_org     <- c(FALSE, rep(FALSE, n_agebands), rep(FALSE, n_stps), rep(TRUE, n_orgs))
  
  # Extract latest point annotation for "Total Only"
  latest_overall <- df_overall |> 
    filter(Week == max(Week))
  
  latest_overall_annotation <- list(
    x = latest_overall$Week,
    y = latest_overall$Vol,
    text = paste0("<b>Total</b>: ", scales::comma(latest_overall$Vol)),
    showarrow = TRUE,
    arrowhead = 2,
    arrowsize = 0.8,
    ax = 30,
    ay = -20,
    font = list(size = 10),
    bgcolor = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)",
    bordercolor = "#1f77b4",
    borderwidth = 1.5
  )
  
  # Extract latest points annotations for "AgeBand"
  latest_ageband <- df_ageband |> 
    group_by(AgeBand) |> 
    filter(Week == max(Week)) |> 
    ungroup()
  
  latest_ageband_annotations <- lapply(1:nrow(latest_ageband), function(i) {
    row <- latest_ageband[i, ]
    band_color <- if (exists("age_palette")) unname(age_palette[as.character(row$AgeBand)]) else NA
    if (is.na(band_color)) band_color <- "#cccccc"
    list(
      x = row$Week,
      y = row$Vol,
      text = paste0("<b>", row$AgeBand, "</b>: ", scales::comma(row$Vol)),
      showarrow = TRUE,
      arrowhead = 2,
      arrowsize = 0.8,
      ax = 30,
      ay = -20,
      font = list(size = 10),
      bgcolor = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)",
      bordercolor = band_color,
      borderwidth = 1.5
    )
  })
  
  # Build plot
  p <- plot_ly() |> 
    # Trace 1: Total
    add_trace(
      data = df_overall,
      x = ~Week,
      y = ~Vol,
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "lines+markers",
      name = "Total",
      marker = list(size = 6),
      line = list(color = "#1f77b4"),
      visible = TRUE
    )
  
  # Traces 2+: By AgeBand
  for (band in unique_agebands) {
    df_sub <- df_ageband |> filter(AgeBand == band)
    band_color <- if (exists("age_palette")) unname(age_palette[as.character(band)]) else NA
    if (is.na(band_color)) band_color <- "#1f77b4"
    
    p <- p |> 
      add_trace(
        data = df_sub,
        x = ~Week,
        y = ~Vol,
        type = "scatter",
        mode = "lines+markers",
        name = band,
        marker = list(size = 6, color = band_color),
        line = list(color = band_color),
        visible = FALSE
      )
  }
  
  # Traces By STP
  for (stp_item in unique_stps) {
    df_sub <- df_stp |> filter(ICB == stp_item)
    
    p <- p |> 
      add_trace(
        data = df_sub,
        x = ~Week,
        y = ~Vol,
        type = "scatter",
        mode = "lines+markers",
        name = stp_item,
        line = list(color = icb_palette[stp_item]),
        marker = list(size = 6, color = icb_palette[stp_item]),
        visible = FALSE
      )
  }
  
  # Traces By Organisation
  for (org in unique_orgs) {
    df_sub <- df_org |> filter(OrganisationName == org)
    
    p <- p |> 
      add_trace(
        data = df_sub,
        x = ~Week,
        y = ~Vol,
        type = "scatter",
        mode = "lines+markers",
        name = org,
        marker = list(size = 6),
        visible = FALSE
      )
  }
  
  # Apply Layout & Updatemenus
  p |> 
    layout(
      title = list(text = p_title),
      yaxis = list(title = list(text = p_yaxis)),
      xaxis = list(
        title = "Week",
        range = if (exists("start_date") && exists("end_date")) list(start_date, end_date) else NULL,
        rangeslider = list(visible = TRUE),
        rangeselector = list(
          x = 0.75, 
          y = 1.1, 
          xanchor = "right",
          yanchor = "top",
          buttons = list(
            list(count = 14, label = "Last 14 Days", step = "day", stepmode = "backward"),
            list(count = 30, label = "Last 30 Days", step = "day", stepmode = "backward"),
            list(count = 90, label = "Last 90 Days", step = "day", stepmode = "backward"),
            list(step = "all", label = "All")
          )
        )
      ),
      updatemenus = list(
        list(
          type = "dropdown",
          direction = "down",
          x = -0.05,
          y = 1.25,
          xanchor = "left",
          yanchor = "top",
          buttons = list(
            list(
              method = "update",
              args = list(
                list(visible = vis_overall),
                list(annotations = list(latest_overall_annotation, policy_annotation))
              ),
              label = "View: Total Only"
            ),
            list(
              method = "update",
              args = list(
                list(visible = vis_ageband),
                list(annotations = c(latest_ageband_annotations, list(policy_annotation)))
              ),
              label = "View: By AgeBand"
            ),
            list(
              method = "update",
              args = list(
                list(visible = vis_stp),
                list(annotations = list(policy_annotation))
              ),
              label = "View: By ICB"
            ),
            list(
              method = "update",
              args = list(
                list(visible = vis_org),
                list(annotations = list(policy_annotation))
              ),
              label = "View: By Trust"
            )
          )
        )
      ),
      shapes = list(
        list(
          type = "line",
          x0 = "2026-09-01",
          x1 = "2026-09-01",
          y0 = 0,
          y1 = 1,
          yref = "paper",
          line = list(color = "#d9534f", width = 2, dash = "dash")
        )
      ),
      annotations = list(latest_overall_annotation, policy_annotation)
    )
}

# Percentage of Ambulance Arrivals Discharged Home
plot_ambulance_conversion_rate <- function(p_title, p_yaxis) {
  
  # All
  df_overall <- df_clean |> 
    filter(Arrival_Mode %in% c("1048031000000100", "1048041000000109", "1048021000000102", "1048051000000107")) |>  # ambulance
    group_by(Week) |> 
    summarise(
      Type1_ambulance = n(),
      Type1_Discharge  = sum(EcdsGroup1 == "Discharged", na.rm = TRUE),
      Conversion_Rate_Pct = round(100 * Type1_Discharge / Type1_ambulance, 2), .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Week + AgeBand
  df_ageband <- df_clean |> 
    filter(Arrival_Mode %in% c("1048031000000100", "1048041000000109", "1048021000000102", "1048051000000107")) |>  # ambulance
    group_by(Week, AgeBand) |> 
    summarise(
      Type1_ambulance = n(),
      Type1_Discharge  = sum(EcdsGroup1 == "Discharged", na.rm = TRUE),
      Conversion_Rate_Pct = round(100 * Type1_Discharge / Type1_ambulance, 2), .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Week + ICB
  df_stp <- df_clean |> 
    filter(Arrival_Mode %in% c("1048031000000100", "1048041000000109", "1048021000000102", "1048051000000107")) |>  # ambulance
    mutate(ICB = if_else(nchar(Stp) > 32, stringr::str_trunc(Stp, width = 32, side = "right", ellipsis = "..."), Stp)) |> 
    group_by(Week, ICB) |> 
    summarise(
      Type1_ambulance = n(),
      Type1_Discharge  = sum(EcdsGroup1 == "Discharged", na.rm = TRUE),
      Conversion_Rate_Pct = round(100 * Type1_Discharge / Type1_ambulance, 2), .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Week + OrganisationName
  df_org <- df_clean |> 
    filter(Arrival_Mode %in% c("1048031000000100", "1048041000000109", "1048021000000102", "1048051000000107")) |>  # ambulance
    group_by(Week, OrganisationName) |> 
    summarise(
      Type1_ambulance = n(),
      Type1_Discharge  = sum(EcdsGroup1 == "Discharged", na.rm = TRUE),
      Conversion_Rate_Pct = round(100 * Type1_Discharge / Type1_ambulance, 2), .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Determine unique categories

  n_agebands <- length(unique_agebands)
  
  unique_stps <- unique(df_stp$ICB)
  n_stps <- length(unique_stps)
  
  unique_orgs <- unique(df_org$OrganisationName)
  n_orgs <- length(unique_orgs)
  
  # Configure visibility vectors for dynamic dropdown
  vis_overall <- c(TRUE,  rep(FALSE, n_agebands), rep(FALSE, n_stps), rep(FALSE, n_orgs))
  vis_ageband <- c(FALSE, rep(TRUE, n_agebands),  rep(FALSE, n_stps), rep(FALSE, n_orgs))
  vis_stp     <- c(FALSE, rep(FALSE, n_agebands), rep(TRUE, n_stps),  rep(FALSE, n_orgs))
  vis_org     <- c(FALSE, rep(FALSE, n_agebands), rep(FALSE, n_stps), rep(TRUE, n_orgs))
  
  # Extract latest point annotation for "Total Only"
  latest_overall <- df_overall |> 
    filter(Week == max(Week))
  
  latest_overall_annotation <- list(
    x = latest_overall$Week,
    y = latest_overall$Conversion_Rate_Pct,
    text = paste0("<b>Total</b>: ", scales::percent(latest_overall$Conversion_Rate_Pct / 100, accuracy = 0.1)),
    showarrow = TRUE,
    arrowhead = 2,

    bgcolor = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)",
    bordercolor = "#1f77b4",

  # Extract latest points annotations for "AgeBand"

    ungroup()
  
  latest_ageband_annotations <- lapply(1:nrow(latest_ageband), function(i) {

      x = row$Week,

      text = paste0("<b>", row$AgeBand, "</b>: ", scales::percent(row$Conversion_Rate_Pct / 100, accuracy = 0.1)),

      add_trace(
        data = df_sub,
        x = ~Week,
        y = ~Conversion_Rate_Pct,
        type = "scatter",
        mode = "lines+markers",
        name = band,
        marker = list(size = 6, color = band_color),
        line = list(color = band_color),
        visible = FALSE
      )
  }
  
  # Traces By STP
  for (stp_item in unique_stps) {
    df_sub <- df_stp |> filter(ICB == stp_item)
    
    p <- p |> 
      add_trace(
        data = df_sub,
        x = ~Week,
        y = ~Conversion_Rate_Pct,
        type = "scatter",
        mode = "lines+markers",
        name = stp_item,
        line = list(color = icb_palette[stp_item]),
        marker = list(size = 6, color = icb_palette[stp_item]),
        visible = FALSE
      )
  }
  
  # Traces By Organisation
  for (org in unique_orgs) {
    df_sub <- df_org |> filter(OrganisationName == org)
    
    p <- p |> 
      add_trace(
        data = df_sub,
        x = ~Week,
        y = ~Conversion_Rate_Pct,
        type = "scatter",
        mode = "lines+markers",
        name = org,
        marker = list(size = 6),
        visible = FALSE
      )
  }
  
  # Apply Layout & Updatemenus
  p |> 
    layout(
      title = list(text = p_title),
      yaxis = list(title = list(text = p_yaxis), ticksuffix = "%"),
      xaxis = list(
        title = "Week",
        range = if (exists("start_date") && exists("end_date")) list(start_date, end_date) else NULL,
        rangeslider = list(visible = TRUE),
        rangeselector = list(
          x = 0.75, 
          y = 1.1, 
          xanchor = "right",
          yanchor = "top",
          buttons = list(
            list(count = 14, label = "Last 14 Days", step = "day", stepmode = "backward"),
            list(count = 30, label = "Last 30 Days", step = "day", stepmode = "backward"),
            list(count = 90, label = "Last 90 Days", step = "day", stepmode = "backward"),
            list(step = "all", label = "All")
          )
        )
      ),
      updatemenus = list(
        list(
          type = "dropdown",
          direction = "down",
          x = -0.05,
          y = 1.25,
          xanchor = "left",
          yanchor = "top",
          buttons = list(
            list(
              method = "update",
              args = list(
                list(visible = vis_overall),
                list(annotations = list(latest_overall_annotation, policy_annotation))
              ),
              label = "View: Total Only"
            ),
            list(
              method = "update",
              args = list(
                list(visible = vis_ageband),
                list(annotations = c(latest_ageband_annotations, list(policy_annotation)))
              ),
              label = "View: By AgeBand"
            ),
            list(
              method = "update",
              args = list(
                list(visible = vis_stp),
                list(annotations = list(policy_annotation))
              ),
              label = "View: By ICB"
            ),
            list(
              method = "update",
              args = list(
                list(visible = vis_org),
                list(annotations = list(policy_annotation))
              ),
              label = "View: By Trust"
            )
          )
        )
      ),
      shapes = list(
        list(
          type = "line",
          x0 = "2026-09-01",
          x1 = "2026-09-01",
          y0 = 0,
          y1 = 1,
          yref = "paper",
          line = list(color = "#d9534f", width = 2, dash = "dash")
        )
      ),
      annotations = list(latest_overall_annotation, policy_annotation)
    )
}

# Time - Mean 
plot_time_summary <- function(p_df, p_title, p_yaxis) {
  
  # 1. Prepare overall data
  df_overall <- p_df |> 
    group_by(Week) |> 
    summarise(Avg_Time = mean(DerEcDuration, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # 2. Prepare group-level data (Week + AgeBand)
  df_ageband <- p_df |> 
    group_by(Week, AgeBand) |> 
    summarise(Avg_Time = mean(DerEcDuration, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # 3. Prepare system-level data (Week + ICB)
  df_stp <- p_df |>  
    mutate(ICB = if_else(nchar(Stp) > 32, stringr::str_trunc(Stp, width = 32, side = "right", ellipsis = "..."), Stp)) |> 
    group_by(Week, ICB) |> 
    summarise(Avg_Time = mean(DerEcDuration, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # 4. Prepare provider-level data (Week + OrganisationName)
  df_org <- p_df |> 
    group_by(Week, OrganisationName) |> 
    summarise(Avg_Time = mean(DerEcDuration, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Determine unique categories
  unique_agebands <- unique(df_ageband$AgeBand)
  n_agebands <- length(unique_agebands)
  
  unique_stps <- unique(df_stp$ICB)
  n_stps <- length(unique_stps)
  
  unique_orgs <- unique(df_org$OrganisationName)
  n_orgs <- length(unique_orgs)
  
  # Configure visibility vectors for dynamic dropdown
  vis_overall <- c(TRUE,  rep(FALSE, n_agebands), rep(FALSE, n_stps), rep(FALSE, n_orgs))
  vis_ageband <- c(FALSE, rep(TRUE, n_agebands),  rep(FALSE, n_stps), rep(FALSE, n_orgs))
  vis_stp     <- c(FALSE, rep(FALSE, n_agebands), rep(TRUE, n_stps),  rep(FALSE, n_orgs))
  vis_org     <- c(FALSE, rep(FALSE, n_agebands), rep(FALSE, n_stps), rep(TRUE, n_orgs))
  
  # Extract latest point annotation for "Total Only"
  latest_overall <- df_overall |> 
    filter(Week == max(Week))
  
  latest_overall_annotation <- list(
    x = latest_overall$Week,
    y = latest_overall$Avg_Time,
    text = paste0("<b>Total</b>: ", scales::comma(latest_overall$Avg_Time)),
    showarrow = TRUE,
    arrowhead = 2,
    arrowsize = 0.8,
    ax = 30,
    ay = -20,
    font = list(size = 10),
    bgcolor = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)",
    bordercolor = "#1f77b4",
    borderwidth = 1.5
  )
  
  # Extract latest points annotations for "AgeBand"
  latest_ageband <- df_ageband |> 
    group_by(AgeBand) |> 
    filter(Week == max(Week)) |> 
    ungroup()
  
  latest_ageband_annotations <- lapply(1:nrow(latest_ageband), function(i) {
    row <- latest_ageband[i, ]
    band_color <- if (exists("age_palette")) unname(age_palette[as.character(row$AgeBand)]) else NA
    if (is.na(band_color)) band_color <- "#cccccc"
    list(
      x = row$Week,
      y = row$Avg_Time,
      text = paste0("<b>", row$AgeBand, "</b>: ", scales::comma(row$Avg_Time)),
      showarrow = TRUE,
      arrowhead = 2,
      arrowsize = 0.8,
      ax = 30,
      ay = -20,
      font = list(size = 10),
      bgcolor = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)",
      bordercolor = band_color,
      borderwidth = 1.5
    )
  })
  
  # Build plot
  p <- plot_ly() |> 
    # Trace 1: Total
    add_trace(
      data = df_overall,
      x = ~Week,
      y = ~Avg_Time,
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "lines+markers",
      name = "Total",
      marker = list(size = 6),
      line = list(color = "#1f77b4"),
      visible = TRUE
    )
  
  # Traces 2+: By AgeBand
  for (band in unique_agebands) {
    df_sub <- df_ageband |> filter(AgeBand == band)
    band_color <- if (exists("age_palette")) unname(age_palette[as.character(band)]) else NA
    if (is.na(band_color)) band_color <- "#1f77b4"
    
    p <- p |> 
      add_trace(
        data = df_sub,
        x = ~Week,
        y = ~Avg_Time,
        type = "scatter",
        mode = "lines+markers",
        name = band,
        marker = list(size = 6, color = band_color),
        line = list(color = band_color),
        visible = FALSE
      )
  }
  
  # Traces By STP
  for (stp_item in unique_stps) {
    df_sub <- df_stp |> filter(ICB == stp_item)
    
    p <- p |> 
      add_trace(
        data = df_sub,
        x = ~Week,
        y = ~Avg_Time,
        type = "scatter",
        mode = "lines+markers",
        name = stp_item,
        line = list(color = icb_palette[stp_item]),
        marker = list(size = 6, color = icb_palette[stp_item]),
        visible = FALSE
      )
  }
  
  # Traces By Organisation
  for (org in unique_orgs) {
    df_sub <- df_org |> filter(OrganisationName == org)
    
    p <- p |> 
      add_trace(
        data = df_sub,

        y = ~Avg_Time,
        type = "scatter",
        mode = "lines+markers",
        name = org,
        marker = list(size = 6),
        visible = FALSE
      )
  }
  
  # Apply Layout & Updatemenus
  p |> 
    layout(
      title = list(text = p_title),
      yaxis = list(title = list(text = p_yaxis)),
      xaxis = list(
        title = "Week",
        range = if (exists("start_date") && exists("end_date")) list(start_date, end_date) else NULL,
        rangeslider = list(visible = TRUE),
        rangeselector = list(
          x = 0.75, 
          y = 1.1, 
          xanchor = "right",
          yanchor = "top",
          buttons = list(
            list(count = 14, label = "Last 14 Days", step = "day", stepmode = "backward"),
            list(count = 30, label = "Last 30 Days", step = "day", stepmode = "backward"),
            list(count = 90, label = "Last 90 Days", step = "day", stepmode = "backward"),
            list(step = "all", label = "All")
          )
        )
      ),
      updatemenus = list(
        list(
          type = "dropdown",
          direction = "down",
          x = -0.05,
          y = 1.25,
          xanchor = "left",
          yanchor = "top",
          buttons = list(
            list(
              method = "update",
              args = list(
                list(visible = vis_overall),
                list(annotations = list(latest_overall_annotation, policy_annotation))
              ),
              label = "View: Total Only"
            ),
            list(
              method = "update",
              args = list(
                list(visible = vis_ageband),
                list(annotations = c(latest_ageband_annotations, list(policy_annotation)))
              ),
              label = "View: By AgeBand"
            ),
            list(
              method = "update",

                list(visible = vis_stp),

            ),

# Conversion Rate
plot_conversion_rate <- function(p_title, p_yaxis) {
  
  # All
  df_overall <- df_clean |> 
    group_by(Week) |> 
    summarise(
      Type1_Attendances = n(),
      Type1_Admissions  = sum(EcdsGroup1 == "Admitted", na.rm = TRUE),
      Conversion_Rate_Pct = round(100 * Type1_Admissions / Type1_Attendances, 2), .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Week + AgeBand
  df_ageband <- df_clean |> 
    group_by(Week, AgeBand) |>

      Type1_Attendances = n(),

        range = if (exists("start_date") && exists("end_date")) list(start_date, end_date) else NULL,
        rangeslider = list(visible = TRUE),

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Narration Function 1 
is_are <- function(x) {
  if_else(length(x) == 1, " is ", " are ")
}
# Narration Function 2
narr <- function(df) {
  df <- df |>
    filter(x == max(x))
  
  improve <- (df$f[df$point_type == "special_cause_improvement"])
  concern <- (df$f[df$point_type == "special_cause_concern"])
  
  nar_imp <- if_else(is_empty(improve), "", 
                     paste0(combine_words(improve), 
                            is_are(improve), 
                            "showing a reduction, "))
  nar_con <- if_else(is_empty(concern), 
                     "", 
                     paste0(combine_words(concern), 
                            is_are(concern), 
                            "showing an increase"))
  
  nar_com <- paste0(nar_imp, " ", nar_con)
  nar_com <- if_else(nar_com == ' ', 'There are no significant trends', nar_com)
}

# SPC Data Function
generate_spc_data <- function(flag_type, category) {
  dft_hour_performance |> 
    filter(Flag == flag_type, Wait_Category == category)
}
# AGE 
generate_spc_age_data <- function(flag_type, category, ageband) {
  dft_hour_performance |> 
    filter(Flag == flag_type, Wait_Category == category, AgeBand == ageband)
}

# SPC All Function
generate_spc_data_single <- function(flag, category){
  plot_data |> 
    ptd_spc(value_field = Percentage, date_field = Week, improvement_direction = "increase") %>% 
    ptd_create_ggplot(y_axis_label = "Percentage of Attendances", percentage_y_axis = TRUE) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0(category, " Weekly ED Type 1 by ", flag),
      subtitle = paste0("Percentages of attendances by length of stay (Last 26 Weeks)")) +
    ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
                   plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10, color = "#555555"))
}

# SPC Facet Function - Stage 1
generate_spc_data_facet <- function(facet_col){
  plot_data |> 
    ptd_spc(value_field = Percentage, date_field = Week, improvement_direction = "increase", facet_field = {{ facet_col }})
}
# SPC Facet Function - Stage 2
generate_spc_data_facet_plot <- function(flag, category, ageband){
  df_facet |> 
    ptd_create_ggplot(iconfixed_y_axis_multiple = FALSE, percentage_y_axis = TRUE, #icons_position = "top left",
                      x_axis_breaks = "3 weeks",
                      point_size = 3,
                      y_axis_label = "Percentage of Attendances") +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0(category, " Weekly ED Type 1 by ", flag),
      subtitle = paste0(ageband, " Percentages of attendances by length of stay (Last 26 Weeks)")) +
    ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
                   plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10, color = "#555555"))
}

# UCR 
plot_ucr_summary <- function(r_group, p_yaxis) {
  
  # SW
  df_overall <- df_ucr |> 
    filter(flag == "SW") |> 
    filter(ResponseCategory == {{r_group}}) |> 
    group_by(Dt) |> 
    summarise(Vol = sum(MeasureValue, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |> 
    arrange(desc(Dt))
  # Age 
  df_ageband <- df_ucr |> 
    filter(flag == "AGE") |> 
    filter(ResponseCategory == {{r_group}}) |> 
    group_by(Dt, AgeBand = Breakdown) |> 
    summarise(Vol = sum(MeasureValue, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") 
  # ICB
  df_stp <- df_ucr |> 
    filter(flag == "ICB") |> 
    filter(ResponseCategory == {{r_group}}) |> 
    group_by(Dt, ICB) |> 
    summarise(Vol = sum(MeasureValue, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |> 
    arrange(desc(Dt))

  # Determine unique categories
  unique_agebands <- unique(df_ageband$AgeBand)
  n_agebands <- length(unique_agebands)
  
  unique_stps <- unique(df_stp$ICB)
  n_stps <- length(unique_stps)

  # Configure visibility vectors for dynamic dropdown
  vis_overall <- c(TRUE,  rep(FALSE, n_agebands), rep(FALSE, n_stps))
  vis_ageband <- c(FALSE, rep(TRUE, n_agebands),  rep(FALSE, n_stps))
  vis_stp     <- c(FALSE, rep(FALSE, n_agebands), rep(TRUE, n_stps))
  
  # Extract latest point annotation for "Total Only"
  latest_overall <- df_overall |> 
    filter(Dt == max(Dt))
  
  latest_overall_annotation <- list(
    x = latest_overall$Dt,
    y = latest_overall$Vol,
    text = paste0("<b>Total</b>: ", scales::comma(latest_overall$Vol)),
    showarrow = TRUE,
    arrowhead = 2,
    arrowsize = 0.8,
    ax = 30,
    ay = -20,
    font = list(size = 10),
    bgcolor = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)",
    bordercolor = "#1f77b4",
    borderwidth = 1.5
  )
  
  # Extract latest points annotations for "AgeBand"
  latest_ageband <- df_ageband |> 
    group_by(AgeBand) |> 
    filter(Dt == max(Dt)) |> 
    ungroup()
  
  latest_ageband_annotations <- lapply(1:nrow(latest_ageband), function(i) {
    row <- latest_ageband[i, ]
    band_color <- if (exists("age_palette")) unname(age_palette[as.character(row$AgeBand)]) else NA
    if (is.na(band_color)) band_color <- "#cccccc"
    list(
      x = row$Dt,
      y = row$Vol,
      text = paste0("<b>", row$AgeBand, "</b>: ", scales::comma(row$Vol)),
      showarrow = TRUE,
      arrowhead = 2,
      arrowsize = 0.8,
      ax = 30,
      ay = -20,
      font = list(size = 10),
      bgcolor = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)",
      bordercolor = band_color,
      borderwidth = 1.5
    )
  })
  
  # Build plot
  p <- plot_ly() |> 
    # Trace 1: Total
    add_trace(
      data = df_overall,
      x = ~Dt,
      y = ~Vol,
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "lines+markers",
      name = "Total",
      marker = list(size = 6),
      line = list(color = "#1f77b4"),
      visible = TRUE
    )
  
  # Traces 2+: By AgeBand
  for (band in unique_agebands) {
    df_sub <- df_ageband |> filter(AgeBand == band)
    band_color <- if (exists("age_palette")) unname(age_palette[as.character(band)]) else NA
    if (is.na(band_color)) band_color <- "#1f77b4"
    
    p <- p |> 
      add_trace(
        data = df_sub,
        x = ~Dt,
        y = ~Vol,
        type = "scatter",
        mode = "lines+markers",
        name = band,
        marker = list(size = 6, color = band_color),
        line = list(color = band_color),
        visible = FALSE
      )
  }
  
  # Traces By STP
  for (stp_item in unique_stps) {
    df_sub <- df_stp |> filter(ICB == stp_item)
    
    p <- p |> 
      add_trace(
        data = df_sub,
        x = ~Dt,
        y = ~Vol,
        type = "scatter",
        mode = "lines+markers",
        name = stp_item,
        line = list(color = icb_palette[stp_item]),
        marker = list(size = 6, color = icb_palette[stp_item]),
        visible = FALSE
      )
  }

  # Layout & Updatemenus
  p |> 
    layout(
      title = list(text = paste0(r_group, " by View")),
      yaxis = list(title = list(text = p_yaxis)),
      xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
      updatemenus = list(
        list(
          type = "dropdown",
          direction = "down",
          x = -0.05,
          y = 1.25,
          xanchor = "left",
          yanchor = "top",
          buttons = list(
            list(
              method = "update",
              args = list(
                list(visible = vis_overall),
                list(annotations = list(latest_overall_annotation, policy_annotation))
              ),
              label = "View: Total Only"
            ),
            list(
              method = "update",
              args = list(
                list(visible = vis_ageband),
                list(annotations = c(latest_ageband_annotations, list(policy_annotation)))
              ),
              label = "View: By AgeBand"
            ),
            list(
              method = "update",
              args = list(
                list(visible = vis_stp),
                list(annotations = list(policy_annotation))
              ),
              label = "View: By ICB"
            )
          )
        )
      ),
      shapes = list(
        list(
          type = "line",
          x0 = "2026-09-01",
          x1 = "2026-09-01",
          y0 = 0,
          y1 = 1,
          yref = "paper",
          line = list(color = "#d9534f", width = 2, dash = "dash")
        )
      ),
      annotations = list(latest_overall_annotation, policy_annotation)
    )
}

# Care Contacts :: care contacts by Consultation Type 
plot_ucr_comms <- function(r_group) {
  df_ucr |> 
    filter(OrgCode != "Y58") |> 
    filter(ResponseCategory == {{r_group}}) |> 
    filter(Breakdown %in% c("Face to face", "Phone", "Telemedicine")) |> 
    group_by(Dt, ICB, Breakdown) |> 
    summarise(Vol = sum(MeasureValue, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = Dt, y = Vol, colour = Breakdown, group = Breakdown)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ ICB, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    labs(
      title = "Care Contacts Volume by Consultation Type", 
      subtitle = {{r_group}},
      x = "Month",
      y = "Referral Volume",
      colour = "Consultation Type"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}
```

```{r Hour Performance}
# 4 & 12 Hour Performance

# Region
t1 <- summary_df %>%
  filter(Week >= lkp_26_week) %>%
  mutate(Stp = if_else(nchar(Stp) > 30, paste0(substr(Stp, 1, 27), "..."), Stp)) %>%
  group_by(Week) %>%
  summarise(
    pct_4hrs = sum(`4Hours`, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Attendances, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_4_12hrs = sum(`4-12Hours`, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Attendances, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_12hrs = sum(`12Hours`, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Attendances, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  mutate(AgeBand = "-") |> 
  mutate(Stp = "-") |> 
  mutate(Flag = "Region") |> 
  select(Week, AgeBand, Stp, everything())

# ICB
t2 <- summary_df %>%
  filter(Week >= lkp_26_week) %>%
  mutate(Stp = if_else(nchar(Stp) > 30, paste0(substr(Stp, 1, 27), "..."), Stp)) %>%
  group_by(Week, Stp) %>%
  summarise(
    pct_4hrs = sum(`4Hours`, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Attendances, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_4_12hrs = sum(`4-12Hours`, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Attendances, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_12hrs = sum(`12Hours`, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Attendances, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  mutate(AgeBand = "-") |> 
  mutate(Flag = "Stp") |> 
  select(Week, AgeBand, Stp, everything())

# AGE
t3 <- summary_df %>%
  filter(Week >= lkp_26_week) %>%
  mutate(Stp = if_else(nchar(Stp) > 30, paste0(substr(Stp, 1, 27), "..."), Stp)) %>%
  group_by(Week, AgeBand, Stp) %>%
  summarise(
    pct_4hrs = sum(`4Hours`, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Attendances, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_4_12hrs = sum(`4-12Hours`, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Attendances, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_12hrs = sum(`12Hours`, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Attendances, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  mutate(Flag = "AgeBand") 

# Combine 
dft <- rbind(t1,t2,t3) 

# Output
dft_hour_performance  <- dft |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("pct_"),
    names_to = "Wait_Category",
    values_to = "Percentage"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Wait_Category = factor(
      Wait_Category,
      levels = c("pct_4hrs", "pct_4_12hrs", "pct_12hrs"),
      labels = c("<4 Hours", "4-12 Hours", ">12 Hours")
    )
  )

```

```{r Virtual Wards}

df_virtual_ward_summary <- df_virtual_ward |>
  filter(MetricName %in% c("Number of VW beds occupied", "Number of VW beds available", "Registered GP Population")) |> 
  mutate(ICB = if_else(nchar(StpName) > 32, str_trunc(StpName, width = 32, side = "right", ellipsis = "..."), StpName)) |>
  group_by(Year, Month, ICB, MetricName) |> 
  summarise(Total_Val = sum(Val, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = MetricName, values_from = Total_Val) |> 
  group_by(ICB) |> 
  fill(`Registered GP Population`, .direction = "downup") |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(
    Bed_Occupancy = `Number of VW beds occupied` / `Number of VW beds available`,
    Beds_Available_per_100k = (`Number of VW beds available` / `Registered GP Population`) * 100000,
    Beds_Occupied_per_100k = (`Number of VW beds occupied` / `Registered GP Population`) * 100000
  ) |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", Year, Month))) |> 
  filter(Date >= (max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) %m-% months(12))) |> # Last 2 Years
  arrange(Date) |> 
  clean_names("upper_camel")

# Latest Data Point
df_latest <- df_virtual_ward_summary |> 
  mutate(BedsAvailablePer100K  = round(BedsAvailablePer100K ,0)) |> 
  mutate(BedsOccupiedPer100K  = round(BedsOccupiedPer100K ,0)) |> 
  group_by(Icb) |> 
  filter(Date == max(Date)) |> 
  ungroup()

```

## Overview

::: columns
```{r}
#| echo: false

# Generate a list of value box objects
boxes <- purrr::pmap(metrics_data, function(metric_name, current_val, target_val, prev_val, lower_is_better, format_type) {
  create_dynamic_value_box(
    metric_name     = metric_name,
    current_val     = current_val,
    target_val      = target_val,
    prev_val        = prev_val,
    lower_is_better = lower_is_better,
    format_type     = format_type
  )
})

# Render
bslib::layout_column_wrap(
  width = 1/5,
  !!!boxes
)

```
:::

<small>*The boxes are colour-coded based on weekly directional performance, where green highlights a positive or improving outcome (a reduction in long waits) and orange indicates a negative or deteriorating trend (increases in total attendances, avoidable visits, and longer wait times) \[ Source : ECDS \].*</small>

## Scope & Regional Context

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## Purpose

This weekly report tracks Urgent and Emergency Care (UEC) Priority 1 metrics across ICB and site levels to support winter resilience and align with NHS strategic goals of shifting care from hospital to community. Using ECDS and ONS data, it monitors age-stratified attendance rates (per 100,000) and quantifies avoidable Type 1 ED presentations by chief complaint, and GP practice.

By tracking 4-hour performance, 12-hour wait times, and total dwell time—with a dedicated focus on the frail elderly (65+)—the report evaluates operational throughput and models potential capacity achieved by directing non-urgent care to local primary services.
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" style="background-color: #f0fff4; border-left-color: green;"}

```{r Attendances}
#| echo: false
```

```{r}
#  Attendances By Chief Complaint

# Distinct
df_colors <- df_spot |> 
  filter(Grp != "Other") |> 
  filter(DataType == "Attendances_Avg") |> 
  distinct(Grp) |> 
  mutate(color = custom_colors[1:n()])

# Add Colours
df_bar_data <- df_spot |> 
  filter(Grp != "Other") |> 
  filter(DataType == "Attendances_Avg") |> 
  left_join(df_colors, by = "Grp")

color_palette <- setNames(df_colors$color, df_colors$Grp)

# Function
create_sorted_bar_chart <- function(data_subset, age_band, show_leg = FALSE) {
  data_sorted <- data_subset |> 
    filter(AgeBand == age_band) |> 
    arrange(desc(Total_Attendances)) |> 
    mutate(Grp = factor(Grp, levels = rev(Grp)))
  
  plot_ly(
    data = data_sorted,
    y = ~Grp,
    x = ~Total_Attendances,
    color = ~Grp,
    colors = color_palette,
    type = "bar",
    orientation = "h",
    text = ~paste0(round(Percentage * 100, 1), "%"),
    textposition = "inside",
    insidetextfont = list(color = "#FFFFFF", size = 12),
    hoverinfo = "x+y",
    showlegend = show_leg
  ) |> 
    layout(
      annotations = list(
        x = 0.5, y = 1.05, text = paste0("<b>", age_band, " Years</b>"), 
        showarrow = FALSE, xref = "paper", yref = "paper", font = list(size = 14)
      ),
      yaxis = list(title = ""),
      xaxis = list(title = "")
    )
}

# Generate 3 ordered bar plots
p1 <- create_sorted_bar_chart(df_bar_data, "0-18", show_leg = TRUE)
p2 <- create_sorted_bar_chart(df_bar_data, "19-64", show_leg = FALSE)
p3 <- create_sorted_bar_chart(df_bar_data, "65+", show_leg = FALSE)

# Combine into side-by-side horizontal bar subplots
subplot(p1, p2, p3, nrows = 1, shareX = TRUE, shareY = FALSE, margin = 0.05) |> 
  layout(
    title = list(
      text = paste0(
        "<b>Average Weekly Attendances (Last 6 Weeks to ", format(max(df_clean$Week, na.rm = TRUE), "%d %b %Y"),
        ")</b><br><sup>Top 5 primary drivers calculated independently for each age demographic</sup>"
      ),
      x = 0,
      font = list(family = "Arial, sans-serif", size = 16, color = "#212529")
    ),
    xaxis2 = list(title = "6 Week Average Attendances"), 
    showlegend = FALSE,
    margin = list(l = 80, r = 10, t = 80, b = 60)
  )
```

### Attendance Map

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

# Data
map_data <- summary_df %>%
  filter(Week == max(Week, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  group_by(Week, OrganisationName) %>%
  summarise(
    `4Hours`      = sum(`4Hours`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `4-12Hours`   = sum(`4-12Hours`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `12Hours`     = sum(`12Hours`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Attendances` = sum(`Attendances`, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups       = "drop"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(site_coords, by = "OrganisationName")

# 2. Define continuous color palettes (1 per line)
pal_att  <- colorNumeric(palette = "YlOrRd", domain = map_data$Attendances) 
pal_h4   <- colorNumeric(palette = "YlOrRd", domain = map_data$`4Hours`)
pal_h412 <- colorNumeric(palette = "YlOrRd", domain = map_data$`4-12Hours`)
pal_h12  <- colorNumeric(palette = "YlOrRd", domain = map_data$`12Hours`)

map_data <- map_data %>%
  mutate(
    col_att  = pal_att(Attendances),
    col_h4   = pal_h4(`4Hours`),
    col_h412 = pal_h412(`4-12Hours`),
    col_h12  = pal_h12(`12Hours`)
  )

# 3. Dynamic radius
total_attendances <- sum(map_data$Attendances, na.rm = TRUE)
dynamic_radius    <- pmin(pmax(round(log10(total_attendances) * 5), 15), 45)

# Define title HTML element
map_title <- HTML(paste0("
  <div style='
    background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
    padding: 8px 14px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
    font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
  '>
    <h3 style='margin: 0 0 4px 0; color: #2c3e50; font-size: 16px;'>A&E Type 1 Activity & Wait Times Density</h3>
    <p style='margin: 0 0 2px 0; color: #7f8c8d; font-size: 11px;'>South West Region | Site Distribution</p>
    <p style='margin: 0; color: #7f8c8d; font-size: 10px; font-style: italic;'>Week Ending (", format(max(map_data$Week), "%d %b %Y"), ")</p>
  </div>
"))


# 4. Build Leaflet map with title control
leaflet(map_data, options = leafletOptions(
  tileAutoOption = FALSE,
  # Pass a custom user agent to satisfy tile provider headers
  headers = list("User-Agent" = "R-Leaflet-Quarto-App")
)) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldTopoMap) |>
  addControl(html = map_title, position = "topleft") |> 
  # Heatmap Base Layers
  addHeatmap(
    data = map_data, lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat, intensity = ~`Attendances`,
    blur = dynamic_radius * 0.8, max = max(map_data$`Attendances`, na.rm = TRUE),
    radius = dynamic_radius, group = "Attendances"
  ) %>%
  addHeatmap(
    data = map_data, lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat, intensity = ~`4Hours`,
    blur = dynamic_radius * 0.8, max = max(map_data$`4Hours`, na.rm = TRUE),
    radius = dynamic_radius, group = "4 Hours"
  ) %>%
  addHeatmap(
    data = map_data, lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat, intensity = ~`4-12Hours`,
    blur = dynamic_radius * 0.8, max = max(map_data$`4-12Hours`, na.rm = TRUE),
    radius = dynamic_radius, group = "4-12 Hours"
  ) %>%
  addHeatmap(
    data = map_data, lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat, intensity = ~`12Hours`,
    blur = dynamic_radius * 0.8, max = max(map_data$`12Hours`, na.rm = TRUE),
    radius = dynamic_radius, group = "12 Hours"
  ) %>%
  
  # Circle Markers
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat,
    radius = ~sqrt(Attendances) / 3,
    color = "#333333",
    fillColor = ~col_att,
    fillOpacity = 0.85,
    stroke = TRUE,
    weight = 1.5,
    layerId = ~OrganisationName,
    options = markerOptions(
      attendances = map_data$Attendances,       h4          = map_data$`4Hours`,
      h412        = map_data$`4-12Hours`,
      h12         = map_data$`12Hours`,
      c_att       = map_data$col_att,
      c_h4        = map_data$col_h4,
      c_h412      = map_data$col_h412,
      c_h12       = map_data$col_h12
    ),
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<strong>", OrganisationName, "</strong><br/>",
      "<strong>Week Ending:</strong> ", format(max(map_data$Week), "%d %b %Y"), "<br/><hr/>",
      "<strong>Attendances:</strong> ", format(`Attendances`, big.mark = ","), "<br/>",
      "<strong>&lt;4 Hours:</strong> ", format(`4Hours`, big.mark = ","), "<br/>",
      "<strong>4-12 Hours:</strong> ", format(`4-12Hours`, big.mark = ","), "<br/>",
      "<strong>12+ Hours:</strong> ", format(`12Hours`, big.mark = ",")
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Radio selection controls
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("Attendances", "4 Hours", "4-12 Hours", "12 Hours"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  
  # JS Listener for radius and fill color sync
  onRender("
    function(el, x) {
      var map = this;
      
      map.on('baselayerchange', function(e) {
        var activeGroup = e.name;
        
        map.eachLayer(function(layer) {
          if (layer instanceof L.CircleMarker && layer.options.attendances) {
            var val = 0;
            var col = '#33a02c';
            
            if (activeGroup === 'Attendances') {
              val = layer.options.attendances;
              col = layer.options.c_att;
            } else if (activeGroup === '4 Hours') {
              val = layer.options.h4;
              col = layer.options.c_h4;
            } else if (activeGroup === '4-12 Hours') {
              val = layer.options.h412;
              col = layer.options.c_h412;
            } else if (activeGroup === '12 Hours') {
              val = layer.options.h12;
              col = layer.options.c_h12;
            }
            
            var newRadius = val > 0 ? Math.sqrt(val) / 3 : 2;
            layer.setRadius(newRadius);
            layer.setStyle({ fillColor: col });
          }
        });
      });
    }
  ")
```

```{r}
# Avoidable Attendances By Chief Complaint

# Distinct
df_colors <- df_spot |>

color_palette <- setNames(df_colors$color, df_colors$Grp)

# Function
create_sorted_bar_chart <- function(data_subset, age_band, show_leg = FALSE) {
  data_sorted <- data_subset |> 
    filter(AgeBand == age_band) |> 
    arrange(desc(Total_Attendances)) |> 
    mutate(Grp = factor(Grp, levels = rev(Grp)))
  
  plot_ly(
    data = data_sorted,
    y = ~Grp,
    x = ~Total_Attendances,
    color = ~Grp,
    colors = color_palette,
    type = "bar",
    orientation = "h",
    text = ~paste0(round(Percentage * 100, 1), "%"),
    textposition = "inside",
    insidetextfont = list(color = "#FFFFFF", size = 12),
    hoverinfo = "x+y",
    showlegend = show_leg
  ) |> 
    layout(
      annotations = list(
        x = 0.5, y = 1.05, text = paste0("<b>", age_band, " Years</b>"), 
        showarrow = FALSE, xref = "paper", yref = "paper", font = list(size = 14)
      ),
      yaxis = list(title = ""),
      xaxis = list(title = "")
    )
}

# Generate 3 ordered bar plots

p2 <- create_sorted_bar_chart(df_bar_data, "19-64", show_leg = FALSE)
p3 <- create_sorted_bar_chart(df_bar_data, "65+", show_leg = FALSE)

# Combine into side-by-side horizontal bar subplots
subplot(p1, p2, p3, nrows = 1, shareX = TRUE, shareY = FALSE, margin = 0.05) |> 
  layout(
    title = list(
      text = paste0(
         "<b>Average Weekly Avoidable Attendances by Chief Complaint (Last 6 Weeks to ", format(max(df_clean$Week, na.rm = TRUE), "%d %b %Y"),

    ),
    xaxis2 = list(title = "6 Week Average Attendances"),

  )
```

```{r}

#| echo: false

# Total
df_overall <- summary_df |> 
  group_by(Week) |>

# Age

# ICB

      summarise(Avoid = sum(Attendances, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),

  ) |>

#

# Trust 
df_org <- summary_df |> 
  group_by(Week, OrganisationName) |>

  inner_join(
    summary_df_avoidable |> 
      group_by(Week, OrganisationName) |> 
      summarise(Avoid = sum(Attendances, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),

  ) |> 
  mutate(pct_avoidable = (Avoid / Attendances) * 100) 

# Determine unique categories
unique_agebands <- unique(df_ageband$AgeBand)
n_agebands <- length(unique_agebands)

# Configure visibility vectors for dynamic dropdown
vis_overall <- c(TRUE,  rep(FALSE, n_agebands), rep(FALSE, n_stps), rep(FALSE, n_orgs))
vis_ageband <- c(FALSE, rep(TRUE, n_agebands),  rep(FALSE, n_stps), rep(FALSE, n_orgs))
vis_stp     <- c(FALSE, rep(FALSE, n_agebands), rep(TRUE, n_stps),  rep(FALSE, n_orgs))
vis_org     <- c(FALSE, rep(FALSE, n_agebands), rep(FALSE, n_stps), rep(TRUE, n_orgs))

# Extract latest point annotation for "Total Only"
latest_overall <- df_overall |> 
  filter(Week == max(Week))

latest_overall_annotation <- list(
  x = latest_overall$Week,
  y = latest_overall$pct_avoidable,
  text = paste0("<b>Total</b>: ", scales::percent(latest_overall$pct_avoidable / 100, accuracy = 0.1)),

)

# Extract latest points annotations for "AgeBand"

  if (is.na(band_color)) band_color <- "#cccccc"
  list(

    borderwidth = 1.5
  )
})

# Build plot

    )

      rangeslider = list(visible = TRUE),

        yanchor = "top",
        buttons = list(
          list(count = 14, label = "Last 14 Days", step = "day", stepmode = "backward"),
          list(count = 30, label = "Last 30 Days", step = "day", stepmode = "backward"),
          list(count = 90, label = "Last 90 Days", step = "day", stepmode = "backward"),
          list(step = "all", label = "All")
        )
      )
    ),
    updatemenus = list(
      list(
        type = "dropdown",
        direction = "down",
        x = -0.05,
        y = 1.25,
        xanchor = "left",
        yanchor = "top",
        buttons = list(
          list(
            method = "update",
            args = list(
              list(visible = vis_overall),
              list(annotations = list(latest_overall_annotation, policy_annotation))
            ),
            label = "View: Total Only"
          ),
          list(
            method = "update",
            args = list(
              list(visible = vis_ageband),
              list(annotations = c(latest_ageband_annotations, list(policy_annotation)))
            ),
            label = "View: By AgeBand"
          ),
          list(
            method = "update",
            args = list(
              list(visible = vis_stp),
              list(annotations = list(policy_annotation))
            ),
            label = "View: By ICB"
          ),
          list(
            method = "update",
            args = list(
              list(visible = vis_org),
              list(annotations = list(policy_annotation))
            ),
            label = "View: By Trust"
          )
        )
      )
    ),
    shapes = list(
      list(
        type = "line",
        x0 = "2026-09-01",
        x1 = "2026-09-01",
        y0 = 0,
        y1 = 1,
        yref = "paper",
        line = list(color = "#d9534f", width = 2, dash = "dash")
      )
    ),
    annotations = list(latest_overall_annotation, policy_annotation)
  )
```

```{r}
    mode = "lines+markers",
    name = "Total",
    marker = list(size = 6),
    line = list(color = "#1f77b4"),
    visible = TRUE
  )

# Traces 2+: By AgeBand
for (band in unique_agebands) {
  df_sub <- df_ageband |> filter(AgeBand == band)
  band_color <- if (exists("age_palette")) unname(age_palette[as.character(band)]) else NA
  if (is.na(band_color)) band_color <- "#1f77b4"
  
  p <- p |> 
    add_trace(
      data = df_sub,
      x = ~Week,
      y = ~Cost_Saving,
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "lines+markers",
      name = band,
      marker = list(size = 6, color = band_color),
      line = list(color = band_color),
      visible = FALSE
    )
}

# Traces By STP
for (stp_item in unique_stps) {
  df_sub <- df_stp |> filter(ICB == stp_item)
  
  p <- p |> 
    add_trace(
      data = df_sub,
      x = ~Week,
      y = ~Cost_Saving,
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "lines+markers",
      name = stp_item,
      line = list(color = icb_palette[stp_item]),
      marker = list(size = 6, color = icb_palette[stp_item]),
      visible = FALSE
    )
}

# Traces By Organisation
for (org in unique_orgs) {
  df_sub <- df_org |> filter(OrganisationName == org)
  
  p <- p |> 
    add_trace(
      data = df_sub,
      x = ~Week,
      y = ~Cost_Saving,
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "lines+markers",
      name = org,
      marker = list(size = 6),
      visible = FALSE
    )
}

# Apply Layout & Updatemenus
p |> 
  layout(
    title = list(text = "Estimated Cost of Avoidable ED Attendances (£)"),
    yaxis = list(
      title = list(text = "Estimated Cost (£)"),
      tickprefix = "£"
    ),
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Week",
      range = if (exists("start_date") && exists("end_date")) list(start_date, end_date) else NULL,
      rangeslider = list(visible = TRUE),
      rangeselector = list(
        x = 0.75, 
        y = 1.1, 
        xanchor = "right",
        yanchor = "top",
        buttons = list(
          list(count = 14, label = "Last 14 Days", step = "day", stepmode = "backward"),
          list(count = 30, label = "Last 30 Days", step = "day", stepmode = "backward"),
          list(count = 90, label = "Last 90 Days", step = "day", stepmode = "backward"),
          list(step = "all", label = "All")
        )
      )
    ),
    updatemenus = list(
      list(
        type = "dropdown",
        direction = "down",
        x = -0.05,
        y = 1.25,
        xanchor = "left",
        yanchor = "top",
        buttons = list(
          list(
            method = "update",
            args = list(
              list(visible = vis_overall),
              list(annotations = list(latest_overall_annotation, policy_annotation))
            ),
            label = "View: Total Only"
          ),
          list(
            method = "update",
            args = list(
              list(visible = vis_ageband),
              list(annotations = c(latest_ageband_annotations, list(policy_annotation)))
            ),
            label = "View: By AgeBand"
          ),
          list(
            method = "update",
            args = list(
              list(visible = vis_stp),
              list(annotations = list(policy_annotation))
            ),
            label = "View: By ICB"
          ),
          list(
            method = "update",
            args = list(
              list(visible = vis_org),
              list(annotations = list(policy_annotation))
            ),
            label = "View: By Trust"
          )
        )
      )
    ),
    shapes = list(
      list(
        type = "line",
        x0 = "2026-09-01",
        x1 = "2026-09-01",
        y0 = 0,
        y1 = 1,
        yref = "paper",
        line = list(color = "#d9534f", width = 2, dash = "dash")
      )
    ),
    annotations = list(latest_overall_annotation, policy_annotation)
  )


```

<small>*The estimated cost per Type 1 ED visit is based on a baseline average of £271.64. Further details are available under 'Data Context & Definitions' sourced from The King's Fund.*</small>
:::

## Time Spent In ED Department

::: {.panel-tabset .nav-pills}
### Average Time

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

plot_time_summary(df_clean, "Average Time Spent In ED Department & By Age", "Minutes")

```

- Spot Week :

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

# Time 
df_spot_time <- df_clean |> 
  filter(Week >= (max_week_clean - lubridate::weeks(5)), !is.na(EcdsGroup1), !is.na(AgeBand)) |> 
  group_by(AgeBand) |> 
  mutate(Grp = forcats::fct_lump_n(EcdsGroup1, n = 5, other_level = "Other"),
         Total_Age_Attendances = n()) |> 
  group_by(AgeBand, Grp) |> 
  summarise(Avg_Time = round(mean(DerEcDuration, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
            Percentage = round(n() / first(Total_Age_Attendances), 3),
            .groups = "drop_last") |> 
  mutate(Rank = min_rank(desc(Avg_Time))) |> 
  ungroup()|> 
  filter(Grp != "Other") |> 
  mutate(Week = max_week_clean)

# Distinct
df_colors <- df_spot_time |> 
  distinct(Grp) |> 
  mutate(color = custom_colors[1:n()])

# Add Colours
df_bar_data <- df_spot_time |> 
  left_join(df_colors, by = "Grp")

color_palette <- setNames(df_colors$color, df_colors$Grp)

# Plot Function - Average Time
create_sorted_bar_chart <- function(data_subset, age_band, show_leg = FALSE) {
  data_sorted <- data_subset |> 
    filter(AgeBand == age_band) |> 
    arrange(desc(Avg_Time)) |> 
    mutate(Grp = factor(Grp, levels = rev(Grp)))
  
  plot_ly(
    data = data_sorted,
    y = ~Grp,
    x = ~Avg_Time,
    color = ~Grp,
    colors = color_palette,
    type = "bar",
    orientation = "h",
    text = ~paste0(round(Percentage * 100, 1), "%"),
    textposition = "inside",
    insidetextfont = list(color = "#FFFFFF", size = 12),
    hoverinfo = "x+y",
    showlegend = show_leg
  ) |> 
    layout(
      annotations = list(
        x = 0.5, y = 1.05, text = paste0("<b>", age_band, " Years</b>"), 
        showarrow = FALSE, xref = "paper", yref = "paper", font = list(size = 14)
      ),
      yaxis = list(title = ""),
      xaxis = list(title = "")
    )
}

# Generate 3 ordered bar plots
p1 <- create_sorted_bar_chart(df_bar_data, "0-18", show_leg = TRUE)
p2 <- create_sorted_bar_chart(df_bar_data, "19-64", show_leg = FALSE)
p3 <- create_sorted_bar_chart(df_bar_data, "65+", show_leg = FALSE)

# Combine into side-by-side horizontal bar subplots
subplot(p1, p2, p3, nrows = 1, shareX = TRUE, shareY = FALSE, margin = 0.05) |> 
  layout(
    title = list(
      text = paste0(
        "<b>Average Time Spent In ED Department & By Age Band (Last 6 Weeks to ", format(max(df_spot_time$Week), "%d %b %Y"), 
        ")</b><br><sup>Top 5 primary drivers calculated independently for each age demographic</sup>"
      ),
      x = 0,
      font = list(family = "Arial, sans-serif", size = 16, color = "#212529")
    ),
    xaxis2 = list(title = "Average Time (Mins)"), 
    showlegend = FALSE,
    margin = list(l = 80, r = 10, t = 80, b = 60)
  )


```

```{r Commentary 3}
#| warning: false

# Data 
dfc3 <- df_clean |> 
  filter(Week >= (max_week_clean - lubridate::weeks(5)), !is.na(EcdsGroup1), !is.na(AgeBand)) |> 
  group_by(AgeBand) |> 
  mutate(Grp = forcats::fct_lump_n(EcdsGroup1, n = 5, other_level = "Other"),
         Total_Age_Attendances = n()) |> 
  group_by(AgeBand, Grp) |> 
  summarise(Avg_Time = round(mean(DerEcDuration, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
            Percentage = round(n() / first(Total_Age_Attendances), 3),
            .groups = "drop_last") |> 
  mutate(Rank = min_rank(desc(Avg_Time))) |> 
  ungroup()|> 
  filter(Grp != "Other") 

# Strings for Each Demography
commentary_0_18  <- generate_age_commentary_time(dfc3, "0-18")
commentary_19_64 <- generate_age_commentary_time(dfc3, "19-64")
commentary_65_plus <- generate_age_commentary_time(dfc3, "65+")

# Combine
commentary_summary3 <- paste(commentary_0_18, commentary_19_64, commentary_65_plus, sep = "<br><br>")

```

`r commentary_summary3`

*The "Other" category aggregates a wide variety of low-volume chief complaints and individual clinical outliers ; while its cumulative total forms a significant percentage of overall ED attendance, no single driver within it holds individual operational significance. (Currently hidden from view)*
:::

## Data Context & Definitions

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" style="background-color: #f0fff4; border-left-color: green;"}
## Policy Change - Urgent and Emergency Care Recovery: Reducing Patient Harm Through Improved Flow

As we continue our preparations for winter and the delivery of our urgent and emergency care recovery plans, we are writing to highlight what remains one of the most significant risks to patient safety across our region: poor flow through the urgent and emergency care pathway.

The most effective way to deliver sustained improvement in these measures is through better flow across the whole urgent and emergency care pathway. We are therefore setting out three actions to be implemented during August and demonstrably impacting from **1 September 2026**.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" style="background-color: #f0fff4; border-left-color: green;"}
### View Avoidable ED Definition

Avoidable (non-urgent) ED attendances here are defined as ED attendances for care that could have been reasonably provided elsewhere. As per NHS Digital (2020), the following HES/SNOMED codes make up the definition.

Emergency Department Type

| **Description**        | **HES code** | **ECDS code** |
|------------------------|--------------|---------------|
| Type 1 Emergency Dept. | 01           | 01            |

Discharge status (attendance disposal)

| **Description** | **HES code** | **ECDS (SNOMED) code** |
|----|----|----|
| Discharged with followup treatment by GP | 02 | 1077021000000100 |
| Discharged no followup required | 03 | 182992009 |
| Left department before treatment | 12 | 1066321000000107 |

Investigation

| **Description**      | **HES code** | **ECDS (SNOMED) code**  |
|----------------------|--------------|-------------------------|
| Urinalysis           | 06           | 27171005                |
| Pregnancy test       | 21           | 167252002, 67900009     |
| Dental investigation | 22           | 53115007                |
| None                 | 24, blank    | 1088291000000101, blank |

Treatment

| **Description** | **HES code** | **ECDS (SNOMED) code** |
|------------------------|------------------------|------------------------|
| Guidance/advice only - written | 221 | 413334001 |
| Guidance/advice only - verbal | 222 | Not applicable |
| Recording vital signs | 30 | Not applicable |
| Dental treatment | 56 | 81733005 |
| Prescription/medicines prepped to take away | 57 | 266712008 |
| None (consider guidance/advice option) | 99, blank | 183964008, blank |
| Prescriptions (retired code) | 07 | Not applicable |

Attendance category

| **Description**                            | **HES code** | **ECDS code** |
|--------------------------------------------|--------------|---------------|
| First Accident & Emergency (ED) attendance | 1            | 1             |

Arrival mode

| **Description** | **HES code** | **ECDS (SNOMED) codes** |
|------------------------|------------------------|------------------------|
| Non-ambulance arrivals | Not 1 | 1048071000000103,1048061000000105,1047991000000102,1048001000000106 |
